translation: Took place in posad Serock, 17 September 1890, 6 PM. Appeared personally Moszek Rozenberg, trader, [unclear: 25/35], and Berek Kołtun, cemetery attendant, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 4 PM died an infant of male sex named Lejbka Margulis, two years of age, son of Jankiel Margulis and of the latter's deceased wife Laja née [unclear: Mitelsbach]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Lejbka Margulis this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
